sources.content:
name: two-wave-development-research

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'codex/two-wave-phase1-*'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/factor_lab/visual_structure/two_wave/**'
      - 'scripts/run_two_wave_research.py'
      - 'scripts/summarize_two_wave_run.py'
      - 'scripts/diagnose_two_wave_rejections.py'
      - 'scripts/audit_two_wave_window_blocks.py'
      - 'tests/unit/test_two_wave*'
      - 'docs/research/**'
      - '.github/workflows/two-wave-research.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: two-wave-research-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  phase-one:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
      - run: python -m pip install -e . editables==0.6
      - run: python scripts/validate_theme_package.py
      - run: python -m pytest -q
      - name: Replay supplied development views with fixed research parameters
        run: >-
          python scripts/run_two_wave_research.py
          --data 'data/development/*.parquet'
          --output cloud_results/two_wave_h0
          --reversal-logs .008,.01,.012
          --replay-bars 1200
      - name: Publish complete per-view morphology aggregates and provenance to native logs
        run: python scripts/summarize_two_wave_run.py --input cloud_results/two_wave_h0
      - name: Diagnose frozen rejection flags without changing the recognizer
        run: >-
          python scripts/diagnose_two_wave_rejections.py
          --input-root cloud_results/two_wave_h0
          --output cloud_results/two_wave_continuation/rejection_diagnostics
      - name: Audit dependence of preselected human review windows without labels
        run: >-
          python scripts/audit_two_wave_window_blocks.py
          --results cloud_results/two_wave_h0
          --output cloud_results/two_wave_continuation/window_block_audit.json
      - name: Fixed perturbation sensitivity without parameter selection
        run: >-
          python scripts/check_two_wave_stability.py
          --data 'data/development/*.parquet'
          --output cloud_results/two_wave_stability
      - run: python scripts/build_two_wave_synthetic_gallery.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: two-wave-phase-one-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            cloud_results/two_wave_h0/
            cloud_results/two_wave_stability/
            cloud_results/two_wave_synthetic/
            cloud_results/two_wave_continuation/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
